items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Of course I do. He went to Paris.

ctx.x: Cab Calloway's band, and Cozy leaving and going to CBS and J. C. Heard taking his place and doing such an admirable job and really making it so smooth and easy to work with. I was there. You know we had an influx of young drummers that came in - Kansas Fields. You remember Fields? Kansas Fields came in. I can't exactly recite the order when Kansas Fields came through. You remember Kansas?
Of course I do. He went to Paris.
I think he's in Chicago now, right?
